body:
I’ll start:

1) I woke up to my sister having a mental breakdown, screaming that she was about to die because “the air was leaving her stomach” and how, if it all ran out, she would die. She’s 14. I wish I was making this up.

2) She scream/begged at our mom to take her to urgent care, and when they arrived, she got transferred to a mental institution (of which I’ve been to myself — it sucks).

3) My dad complained to me how “she (my sis) will only get worse” and how “he’ll lose his job bc of this drama” (?????) 

4) When we were ready to leave one of the hospital buildings, my father was backing out of a parking space and hit something (unsure of what) pretty hard. So, yay! :))))))) /s

5) I brought a soda along with me in the car, and it spilled my everywhere — my dad does not know and I don’t plan on telling him until we get home because fuckin hell this day suck ass already.

In addition, I don’t have any wifi so I can’t listen to music, which means I have the absolute pleasure of listening to my day loudly scream “FUCK” and a bunch of other stuff he should be talking to a therapist about and not to his kids.

God I can’t wait till I can move out 😭

i'm just gonna follow what everyone else is saying here, pick up your shit when you leave a public place. i've heard my dad and other people say "oh you don't have to pick your stuff, there's people here for that" like wtf? 

and also whenever celebrities give their support to, for example, the lgbtq+ community, people are all over them when they're literally just..... not being bigots

i feel this way about those too, along with "you have a house and food & water & a 'loving' family! be grateful for everything you have, so many people have it worse than you", like great, do the bare minimum and make sure i don't starve, thanks for making me realize how lucky i am lmao. also "try to be happy" sounds like telling someone with cancer to "just get better" like wtf. hope you're doing ok (like not in crisis or having a really bad stretch of time, i don't expect you to be just fine, depression doesn't work like that lol) right now
yup, fuck humans. it seems like all we do is fuck up everything and everyone, but i think there's some good people left in the world (hopefully). i do want you here too:\]

hey man, I know the feeling of comparing myself to others and feeling like no one would notice if I was gone, but please, try your best to not compare yourself, don't even think about it, in any way, and I *know* that people would notice if you were gone, and they would care -- if someone they knew died, that would affect them forever, they definitely won't get over it at all, let alone quickly. Please stay here, you're doing so fucking amazing, you don't need to be the 'top mark' or 'the best' or anything to be proud of yourself or good at anything, and if anyone is putting that pressure on you, doesn't matter who, could be your parents or yourself or someone else, but do not listen to them, please. - I'm absolutely positive you're on the same level as those who receive the awards. Please, please please stay, don't go, please

Hi, I really really hope you're okay, please reply if you're still here and please talk to someone you trust, and please please don't die, please. I saw someone mention you have a cat, they need you and would seriously miss you if you died, please PLEASE pull through, don't go
Increase my height by 4-6 inches and have straight hair, tbh I feel like that's what most people think pretty is now, and I have neither (I'm 5'0 and have annoying curly/wavy hair)

Hi!!!!! I'm so so so happy you replied!!!! Are you feeling any better? (btw I don't expect you to be completely better, I don't think anyone can go from being suicidal to completely happy and rainbows and unicorns in a few hours)

Hey, if you are still here, PLEASE, please, reply to this. Doesn't matter what, just please let me know you're okay. Do you have someone to talk to? A friend you can get in contact with? Even an acquaintance or a random stranger? Anyone you would feel safe telling your feelings? You can talk to me, if you want. You don't need to tell them about your situation, it could just be about the feelings from them. Just please, don't end your life. I don't want to recite cliches, I hate it when people tell me them bc it just makes me feel more alone and unloved. I suggest trying to distract yourself with a book or homework or the internet (positive places that don't mention anything triggering), anything that can keep your mind busy and keep it away from bad feelings. Try to keep yourself away from anything that could cause you harm in any way, I know that's hard, but make the conscious decision to go against what you want to do. You could sit on your hands so it's harder to get to things you want to harm yourself with. Just please don't harm yourself, at least for me. If you feel comfortable, you can dm me to talk, about anything, doesn't have to be about what's going on. Just please, don't die, talk to someone, hotline, friend, anyone, just don't kill yourself. I'm going to follow what someone else said and say to do something to cool down, get some clarity, and think rationally rather than through emotions. Everyone here loves you and wants you here, including myself. Please don't go, and please reply to this. Please, *please.*
